question: In SPL set 89b860d2-de83-468e-b7e8-76aeec2edca2 version 9, section '4 CONTRAINDICATIONS' (direct text only), classify 'decompensated cirrhosis'.
supporting_quote_or_value: Acute liver failure or decompensated cirrhosis [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)].
rationale: Patients with acute liver failure or decompensated cirrhosis are listed in the CONTRAINDICATIONS section: Vytorin must not be used in them.
uncertainty: Could be read as an underlying condition; it is classed by the section's explicit 'contraindicated' wording. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors in the same list are contraindicated co-medications, a different class. Scoped to SPL 89b860d2-de83-468e-b7e8-76aeec2edca2 v9 (effectiveTime 20260121) and this passage only.
